arguments.title: Documentation Checklist: Asyncio Task Cancellation Handling
arguments.body:
- Verify that examples show checking `task.cancelled()` before calling `set_result()`/`set_exception()` on a Future (see https://docs.python.org/release/3.6.15/library/asyncio-dev.html).
- Ensure guidance mentions using `asyncio.wait_for()` timeout behavior which cancels the waited task (see https://docs.python.org/release/3.6.15/library/asyncio-dev.html).
- Confirm that the documentation warns against using asynchronous generators in parallel tasks or across multiple event loops to prevent cancellation issues (see https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-dev.html).
